implementation_status: Original H.264 SPS/PPS, slice and scaling-SRAM translators plus an isolated non-DMA register probe implemented; frame decode and encode not implemented

target.encoder_api: V4L2; select an upstream interface after the hardware control model is established
target.userspace: GStreamer v4l2codecs for Request API decoding
target.codec_firmware: no proprietary codec firmware or libvcodec dependency in the target implementation

provenance.implementation_inputs: Published hardware interface facts, public GPL MediaTek kernel register definitions, public Linux UAPI and independently observed hardware behavior
provenance.note: Existing kernel framework and resource drivers are open source. This is an independent implementation target, not a claim that a formally separated clean-room project has already been completed.

sources.scope: Public encoder UAPI; software bitstream construction in kernel discouraged
Userspace integration target; not yet qualified on Gemini

coverage.functional_specification: Sections 6.7 and 6.8 describe CPU-programmed decoding/encoding. No conclusion about a mandatory codec firmware follows from the upstream VPU/SCP driver.
coverage.decoder_register_table: Section 4.7, pages 799-820, documents VDEC_GCON, not the frame-programming banks.
coverage.encoder_register_table: Section 4.8, pages 821-822, documents three clock/chip-enable registers, not frame programming.
coverage.existing_kernel: No MT6797 match in mtk-vcodec; the configured mtk-jpeg driver is separate. The MT6797 encoder DT node is disabled. CONFIG_COMMON_CLK_MT6797_VDECSYS is disabled; a temporary build of the existing open-source clock provider was used during the non-DMA probe.
coverage.related_silicon: Public MT8173 kernel hardware verification code supplies candidate H.264 frame/slice, scaling SRAM, reference, bitstream and reset interfaces. Their compatibility with MT6797 remains subject to hardware tests.

missing_contracts: MT6797 qualification of candidate decoder frame/slice register fields and sequencing, including references, quantization and start/completion
Encoder source/reference/bitstream buffer fields, picture commands, rate control and completion
Exact decoded tile layout, strides and alignment, including mapping to a Linux pixel format
Scratch-buffer sizes and lifetimes, DMA alignment and address units
MT6797 qualification of decoder interrupt status and acknowledge sequence (SPI 240 level-low resource is known)
Reset/timeout recovery that quiesces DMA before returning or freeing buffers

required: Decoded output compared against software reference across intra, inter, multi-slice and resolution-change cases
Encoded output decoded by an independent software decoder and checked against quality/rate targets
Malformed controls, invalid references, timeout, streamoff, close, suspend and repeated-open tests
On-board measurement of throughput, CPU use, thermals and IOMMU/kernel errors

host_tests.coverage: Independent SPS/PPS and slice word fixtures, signed QP, bounds and atomic rejection, 4x4/8x8 Linux scaling-list order, SRAM locations and coefficient byte order

register_probe_result.note: Expected AVC readback was not obtained. The public reference reads status fields from AVC_CONTROL but does not read back SPS/PPS. Zero readback therefore neither proves register incompatibility nor validates accepted control programming. Output comparison after real frame submission is required.

related_silicon_reference.compatibility_evidence: All seven H.264 register-bank bases match the MT6797 functional specification. CONFIG_CHIP_VER_CURR=80 selects the MT8580-class VLD_TOP path in this MT8173 kernel test interface. Bank matching is not proof of command, tile-layout or DMA compatibility.

implemented_components.control_translator: research/mt6797-vdec/mt6797-h264-controls.c; progressive 8-bit 4:2:0 SPS/PPS, slice-header fields, scaling-SRAM packing, signed fields and atomic validation
implemented_components.register_probe: research/mt6797-vdec/probe.c; separate temporary module, no DMA buffers, IRQ registration or frame start
